name: ghastly-corrosion-refuses-memory-only-item-destroys-low-reserve-item
notes: Ghastly Corrosion: of Scepter of Lumina (memory cost 1, no reserve cost) and Forest Cake (reserve cost 2) only Forest Cake is a legal target -- the memory-only item is refused. Pre-fix both were offered.

rulesClauses: Destroy target item or weapon with memory cost 0 or reserve cost 4 or less.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated target filter for this card tested "CardCost_memory($id) == 0 || CardCost_reserve($id) <= N" for "memory cost 0 or reserve cost N or less". The card data uses -1 for "no such cost", so every memory-only item/weapon/regalia (memory cost 1+, no reserve cost; 139 cards, e.g. Scepter of Lumina) satisfied "reserve <= N" and was offered as a legal target. The generated file cannot be edited (gitignored): the closures are overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with ItemLowCostMatches() (Custom/GameLogic.php): explicit memory cost 0, or a real reserve cost (>= 0) of at most N. Same filter fixed for Converge Reflections, Unstable Fractal, Alkahest, Rapid Combustion, Ghastly Corrosion, Swooping Talons, Reduce to Ash and Smashing Force.
